verses.gurmukhi: ਰਤਨ ਮਣੀ ਗਲਿ ਬਾਂਦਰੈ ਕਿਹੁ ਕੀਮ ਨ ਜਾਣੈ।
verses.translit_en: ratan manee gal baa(n)dharai kih keem na jaanai|

en.bdb: The monkey knows no worth of the jewellary tied to its neck.

verses.gurmukhi: ਕੜਛੀ ਸਾਉ ਨ ਸੰਮ੍ਹਲੈ ਭੋਜਨ ਰਸੁ ਖਾਣੈ।
verses.translit_en: kaRachhee saau na sa(n)mhalai bhojan ras khaanai|

en.bdb: Even being in the food, the ladle does not know the taste of the dishes.

verses.gurmukhi: ਡਡੂ ਚਿਕੜਿ ਵਾਸੁ ਹੈ ਕਵਲੈ ਨ ਸਿਞਾਣੈ।
verses.translit_en: ddaddoo chikaR vaas hai kavalai na sin(j)aanai|

en.bdb: The frog always lives in mire but still knows not the lotus.

verses.gurmukhi: ਨਾਭਿ ਕਥੂਰੀ ਮਿਰਗ ਦੈ ਫਿਰਦਾ ਹੈਰਾਣੈ।
verses.translit_en: naabh kathooree mirag dhai firadhaa hairaanai|

en.bdb: Having musk in its navel the deer runs around confused.

verses.gurmukhi: ਗੁਜਰੁ ਗੋਰਸੁ ਵੇਚਿ ਕੈ ਖਲਿ ਸੂੜੀ ਆਣੈ।
verses.translit_en: gujar goras vech kai khal sooRee aanai|

en.bdb: The cattle breeder puts the milk on sale but fetches home, the oil cakes and husk.

verses.gurmukhi: ਬੇਮੁਖ ਮੂਲਹੁ ਘੁਥਿਆ ਦੁਖ ਸਹੈ ਜਮਾਣੈ ॥੪॥
verses.translit_en: bemukh moolahu ghuthiaa dhukh sahai jamaanai ||4||

en.bdb: The apostate is a person basically gone astray and he undergoes the sufferings given by the Yama.
